## Activity Source checklist

If this adds or changes an Activity Source, confirm:

- [ ] Exact surface is named. Not just a brand.
- [ ] Idle proof is documented.
- [ ] Active proof is documented.
- [ ] Stop proof is documented, including delayed cleanup if needed.
- [ ] The signal does not count "app open", "server alive", or "model loaded" as work.
- [ ] Any config edit is merged/backed up and cleanup removes only StayUp-owned entries.
- [ ] The source uses only supported v1 types: `reported`, `file`, `logPattern`, `socket`, or `process`.
